in_marathi.name: Bahurani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bahurani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bahurani is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Bahu’ meaning ‘many’ and ‘Rani’ meaning ‘queen’ or ‘goddess’. This name is associated with the goddess of wealth and prosperity, Lakshmi. It is believed that the name Bahurani bestows the blessings of wealth, fortune, and prosperity upon the bearer.
